notes.title: Patch Update + CraftCraft Bundle!
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone! Oak here.[/p][p][/p][p]Here's a small little update on Death and Taxes for you![/p][p][/p][p]We've been polishing the Japanese translation for the game and we did notice that there were some font issues for the game popping up so I made a quick pass to make sure that all the languages fonts were rendering correctly. So, hopefully no more missing characters or strange invalid characters appearing![/p][p][/p][p]Meanwhile, we did release our new game, [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2226430/CraftCraft_Fantasy_Merchant_Simulator/"]CraftCraft[/url], and I would be truly grateful if you would check it out![/p][p][/p][p]We even have a bundle for it, meaning that if you already [b]own[/b] Death and Taxes, CraftCraft will be available to you at an additional -15% discount in addition to our launch discount![/p][p][/p][p]Check out the bundle right [url="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/54671/Craft_and_Taxes/"]HERE[/url][/p][p][/p][p]While we are still hard at work on polishing CraftCraft and adding additional content for it, rest assured Death and Taxes is not forgotten! We still have plans to add  a stats screen for your dealings of death and also a sandbox mode later on, although at what point we release that is still unclear. Once we have a better picture or how CraftCraft is doing, I'll be letting you know  ^_^[/p][p][/p][p]For now, that's it! Please do continue to give us your honest feedback about both Death and Taxes, and CraftCraft, as that will help us make both games the best they can be. And as always, thank you all for your continued support <3[/p][p][/p][p]Much love,[/p][p]-Death and Taxes[/p]

notes.title: Death and Taxes @ SimFest... in Spanish! (Also, hats)
notes.content:
Hello Grims! Oak here.

I love to be the bringer of good news and I'm proud to say that we have finally finished up the Spanish translation! Many, many thanks to all the people who helped get this done!

Much love to:
[list]
[*] Luka Giacco
[*] María Geraldía Villar
[*] B-Retz
[*] ChrisDK
[*] Salvador Manuel Quezada Godoy
[*] Christine "Dottie" Dottle
[*] JoseB
[*] Kassiopeia
[*] Literally King Arthur (Vic)
[*] Lucia
[*] Razsher
[*] kasseto
[*] killunya
[*] Ramiro Cibrián Carrasco
[/list]

We finally made it. I'm so happy. I know many of you have been asking for a Spanish translation even before we released the full game, so, here it is! I hope you enjoy it. I can't stress enough how glad I am for us to have such an awesome community ^_^

On top of that, we're also participating in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/simfest2024]SimFest[/url] right here on Steam! Give the organizers (Fireshine Games, Stray Fawn, and Future Friends Games) and participants some love and be sure to check out all the cool games being showcased. To commemorate the occasion, we're gonna be a chill -80% off for 10 days until August 3rd!

And last but not least, I do want to do a quick reminder, that we did add some new content to the game, namely: hats!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36100298/0cc781d02fcd0c765bad860f82aaca71f2795adc.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36100298/1655bbaf6f7ca58352b63936674a043acdd66c18.png[/img]


So if you want to give the game another go, and play around while being a bit more dapper, now's your chance ^_^

Ahhh I'm so glad I can finally say that we got the game done in Spanish. Do note that the translation is going to be updated in the coming days and there may be some small adjustments to the texts here and there, because we really wanted to get the update out by today, because of the start of our participation in SimFest. I do hope that you'll have a good time with the game!

And that's it for now. Thank you for all of your support, it's been a wonderful four and a half years of Death and Taxes already.

Also as a quick teaser... Death and Taxes will also be on mobiles soon >_>
I'll let y'all know when it drops. But until then...

Much love,
-Death and Taxes

notes.title: HALLOWEEN UPDATE RELEASED! [+HOTFIX 1.2.4]
notes.content:
Oak here! Lets cut to the chase: we're happy to announce that we've released the long-awaited Halloween Update for Death & Taxes! Go to your Steam Library RIGHT MEOW and grab the update!

[b][Hotfix changelog at the bottom of this post][/b]

To commemorate this momentuous occasion, Death and Taxes will be -40% off for the duration of the Halloween Sale! [b]PLUS, we are extending this sale until the [u]16th of November[/u]![/b] We felt like this is only fair due to you folks who are still on the fence and might not be able to afford it right during Halloween <3

And do check out the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/16185/The_Bundle_of_Consequences/?snr=1_5_9__403]Bundle of Consequences[/url] if you like games such as Death and Taxes because we're in damn fine company there!

What you can expect in the update:
[list][*]Unlocked the [b]Cerberus' Den[/b] Bar area in Fately Towers! (Open on weekends after work hours)[/*][*][b]7[/b] new characters to meet in Cerberus' Den[/*][*]Over [b]1000[/b] new dialogue lines, fully voiced[/*][*]A whopping [b]16[/b] spirits to imbibe (including milk for calcium)[/*][*]Over [b]50[/b] new character profiles to discover[/*][*][b]2[/b] brand new visages, one spookier than the other[/*][*][b]6[/b] new articles of clothing to reap with in style[/*][*]Spooky new [b]desk friends[/b] to discover![/*][*][b]New music[/b] to chill to when hanging out with fellow Grims and others[/*][*][b]10[/b] new achievements to hunt down![/*][/list]



[h2]This is Halloween, EVERYBODY MAKE A SCENE! <3[/h2]

[previewyoutube=gFm_Xlh7pqM;full][/previewyoutube]



If you've gotten this far, I would also like to say a few words about life, Death and Taxes, and everything. 

It's been over 8 months now since the release of Death and Taxes and it's been strange and amazing at the same time. We didn't expect this level of reception and we are still surprised every day at how many new people get into the game and share their experiences with us. We have a wonderful community (Yot, y'all, you know who you are) and perhaps most notably, we've heard accounts from people having played the game thinking about what death means for them. Thinking about how it has affected their lives and how it has shaped them as people. This is what we set out as our main goal when creating the game. We didn't want to force our own thoughts on all the people playing the game, rather, we wanted to create an entry point. Something neat, funny and stress-free so that people could enjoy themselves while playing and also to contemplate. This has led to some of the most interesting public and private conversations I've had, and it's amazing to see that we did in fact succeed with our main goal.

When we decided to make this update, it was a direct response to all of your feedback and your cherishment for the game (we have over a THOUSAND reviews here, what???). We wanted to put in the things we didn't have the time for initially, and to add or fix things that echoed the most when talking to you. Now this has been done, and while we will continue to support the game if issues do prop up somewhere, in all likelyhood, we won't be adding any more content. We have a specific vision when it comes to this game, and we don't want to compromise that experience too much: short and bittersweet.

So, as we near this holiday of spirits... spare a thought for those who are not beside us anymore in these times, but whom we still carry within us, and celebrate their spirits in both life and whatever comes after.

Thank you so much, for everything. Seriously <3

Much love,

Death and Taxes



[b]EDIT: Do note that we have uploaded a hotfix, check your game version at the bottom left of your screen, you should see version 1.2.4, if not, restart Steam :)[/b]

notes.title: Development Update 12: The First Week
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Oak reporting in.

So the first week has been a DOOZY. We've been doing pretty well, mostly in bug-fix mode and just trying to handle the communication from the release. It's been hectic, to say the least. We've fixed most of the bugs with the release, and now v1.1.7 should be really, really stable.

We've had some issues with people losing progress, but this hole has now been plugged and hopefully the issue will not rear its ugly head again.

And the reception.. has been amazing. We've been doing much much better than we could have ever expected and the reviews here have been so inspiring to read. We've even been blessed to have actually constructive negative reviews, which is a plus! Thank you to everyone who has taken the time to write what they feel about the game! It's very rewarding to see... more than I can say. Thank you.


In addition, we've found and fixed some issues with missing/incorrect VO files and some platform specific issues. [b]You have my eternal gratitude for being patient with us, and most importantly: thank you for reporting all the issues! It has helped me fix everything much faster than usual.[/b] I literally couldn't have done it without the help of the community here.


As for what's next for Death and Taxes? Well, we are considering localization! We also wish to port it over to Switch, if possible, so we're looking at what our options are in that regard. We already have a Traditional Chinese and German description on our Steam page, and if things go well, we will test out how localization works out for us quite soon :) 


For now, that's it from me ^_^

Make sure to check out the sale if you're still on the fence about buying Death and Taxes. Next week I will probably talk about how we've performed and how our stats look! Spoiler: it's looking pretty good.



Much love!

Death and Taxes

PS: Banner is fan art by our community member Foxton <3

notes.title: Development Update 10: Price Announcement and Demo Update
notes.content:
Hello Grims!

Oak here...

[h3]We're just a week away from release! And it's about time that we finally announce the release price for the game! We will be launching at $12.99/€11.99/£10.99![/h3]

We do want to have a launch sale at around [b]-25%[/b] across all platforms as a thank you to our fans and early adopters! ^_^

Make sure to wishlist us if you haven't yet, to get notified when we release on 20th February!

To commemorate this special moment, here's a brand new trailer!
[previewyoutube=qOFC1dnDlno;full][/previewyoutube]

So, what have we been up to the past week? Well, mostly polishing, as one might imagine! 

To showcase this, we've also updated our demo! It now supports all common aspect ratios (16:9, 16:10, 21:9, 3:2, 5:4, 4:3 and I guess anything inbetween?) and the Twitch integration is available to be tested as well! In addition, the demo is now fully voiced! We have the entire voiceover for Fate done now, ready to be released :3


That being said, we're also very happy to announce the latest addition to our cast - [url=https://blackcatbonifide.com/]Bonnie Bogovich[/url]! She will be voicing the inner voice, the perpetual companion to any Grim Reaper - The Conscience. You can find your Conscience in the game by looking deep into the Mirror...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36100298/a5c19dc5407de19c40cc96fe8a943d1bd1efe638.png[/img]

I just finished cutting/mastering half of the dialogue with Conscience and it's really, really solid! Lots of fun, disturbing and lore-heavy discussions to be had with one's self, heheh.


Only one week to go. Intense testing and content polishing ahoy!

Oh... Also. We actually did get played by Markiplier. 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CK-I6jcNNtw


Crazy.

Absolutely crazy.

I guess this is it. One more devlog, one more week away till we are actually released.

Thank you so much to everyone for joining us on this weird and wonderful voyage across teh_interwebz.


Be seeing you.



Much love!

Death and Taxes

notes.title: Development Update 9: i have no idea what im doing (RELEASE IN 2 WEEKS)
notes.content:
Hey Grims! Oak here.

So the last week has been pretty hectic. SO hectic in fact, that I forgot to do the regular Wednesday blog post. Oops!

So where are we with the project? We're just about to finish all the stuff! We just have the voice-over for all the characters to go and then we need to do a round of balancing and finish up the ending sequence. And then just polish as much as we can, haha. Ha. Aaaaaaa.... Yeah it's fun.

We've had some great things happen, we had a pretty big video by jacksepticeye (a pretty well-known YouTuber), which you can check out here:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gA9vsyPRncY


Loved his playthrough! And hopefully he'll play some more of it! Our original dream, or rather, Leene's original dream, was for Markiplier to make a video of the game. This might mean that we're one step closer to doing so? 

Leene said she'd break down crying if that happens (because she's a huge Markiplier fan). And, well, so am I. So I dunno, if you have nothing better to do, then you all could just tell Markiplier to check his e-mail inbox for the [b]preview key[/b] we sent him? :D


Leene also made a nice infographic of the "DnD alignment" of the bigger YouTubers we've had playing our game and it checks out lol

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36100298/29b099488dc684fe947f4e0f1f6470f936737db8.png[/img]

The goal is to get Markiplier on board so we can fill out the Lawful Good section (he's such a sweetheart!)



That being said, there's still work to do. We're adding some fidelity to our ending sequences, like this one:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36100298/a8e3e6254ce497645213b448c9c30d8c794b2a05.gif[/img]


This is just a meme though >_>

I don't want to spoil any of the endings, so you'll have to see what happens for yourself in the full release!

Ooh, and we did get our Shopkeeper voice-over implemented! ALL OF IIIIT:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=s8MoJZjULeE



That's it for today. URGHHH. Wish us luck! And stay grim!

Much love!

Death and Taxes

notes.title: Development Update 5: Happy New Year!
notes.content:
Hello Grims! Oak here.

A little oops happened in our scheduling so I'm posting our (THIS YEAR'S FIRST) devlog a bit later than intended. Much, much later >_>

But it's still this week, so yay! This is our 5th consecutive devlog on Steam! And yes I do realize we missed a week inbetween, but it was the holidays, and we didn't have much to show... BUT ANYWAY

[h2]*fanfares blare*[/h2]

We've been busily working on the game with most features done! Just need to do some testing and finish up the rest of the content (mostly end-game related) and then work on balancing the game (yay.), and then we're done! It feels surreal to think that we're launching already next month...

So what's been up?

So far we've added:

The Chaos Globe (Threnody to Desolation)!

You can see how the world of the living reacts to your choices.. in cute snowglobe form!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36100298/78918443903cbc6b5461007310511adc5a3aa67a.gif[/img]

We also added Twitch integration! Just use the Necrotelecomnicon (The Red Book for short) to commune with the Spirits of The Ether Realms.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36100298/825c1b279cb31d4fb6b76978c1130c42d3b4386b.gif[/img]

So if you're a Twitch streamer who is eager to share their experiences, you can now do exactly that!

Most of our time starting from this week is going to be focused on marketing, so we get more eyes on the game, and to generate interest! You, too, can help us with this! It's quite simple.. all you have to do is just.. talk about the game! To just about anyone, really. Friends, family, acquaintances, anybody you wish. Every little bit helps us a ton. Of course, if people wishlist the game on Steam, it's even more powerful, so we can please the almighty algorithm gods to become more visible on Steam as a direct consequence. So, if you haven't done so already, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1166290/Death_and_Taxes/]wishlist us here on Steam[/url]! ^_^



That's it for this week. Stay tuned till next Wednesday to find out about our logo and character evolution.



Much love!

Death and Taxes

notes.title: Development Update 2
notes.content:
Hello hello! It's Oak again.

Quick update on the demo situation: I fixed a small issue where the game wouldn't quit properly the first time you would try to do so. Nothing big, but still significant enough to note because it might have bothered you.

We've been working on mostly getting the content done by the end of the year. We have 2 weeks of the game done, with some additional days from Week 3 trudging along and a greyboxed version of the entire plot, which we will start testing shortly. Seems like our timeline is still going to pan out.

And last week we finished our elevator scene! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36100298/547d2f2390bda0b2ff3ba6052fe634370f1bc8b7.png[/img]

The Grim Office (the place where your desk is), as seen from the elevator.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36100298/decfdcfa893dfcfc0fd7a9ad48933be7b97d61fa.png[/img]

And this is your room! Complete with a mirror where you can choose your appearance, like this one:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36100298/ad5587301b888b210c27dd36e21c0bca7cda9eed.jpg[/img]

[b]Yes, you can be Punk Cthulhu.[/b]

There are actually a lot of visual combinations that you can choose from with the mirror. If my math is correct (it rarely is), you will have [b]1152[/b] possible combinations, out of [b]8[/b] heads which have [b]6[/b] variations, and [b]3[/b] clothing sets which have [b]8[/b] variations. Try and get them all!

[previewyoutube=UCVaN3fltXI;full][/previewyoutube]

Excel at your job, and you might collect enough souls to barter at the shop in the basement of the Office Tower!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36100298/3724d728a094e4603ccdc87f7566f715b3069a74.png[/img]

Who knows what else you can find in Quartermaster Mortimer's Plunder Emporium! The ever-humble Mortimer will gladly part ways with their treasure, if you have the, uh, currency.

That being said, I really like to see how the game is coming together. I've been a part of many game productions now and this is usually the most stressful phase: to make sure everything comes together. Even though it can be stressful (it's surprisingly not as stressful as I had thought), it's wonderful to see all the cool stuff in the game, working, as it should be. It's very motivating as well, to say the least!

Our team is amazing, to be honest, and their work is about to hit the spotlight... Only a few more months until release!

If you want to say hi or chat with us or give us your feedback and ideas, join us on our social media! You can find us on [url=https://www.facebook.com/DeathandTaxesgame/]Facebook[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/DeathNTaxesGame]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/GNHBWSV]Discord[/url]. The quickest way to join in on the conversations is Discord, because we lurk there all the time anyway.

Till next time, and stay Grim, everyone :)



Much love!

Death and Taxes

notes.title: Development Update 1
notes.content:
Hi everyone! Oak here!

As a quick introduction, most of the presence you'll see around social media concerning Death and Taxes will be either by me (oakwarrior) or Leene (freakoftheyear). I'm the programmer on the project, and also a bit of a project manager, while Leene is the lead artist and also the project lead. I'll probably make a longer introduction about the team (we're about 6 people) in another post :)

I'll keep this week's devlog fairly short, just with a few updates on what we've been doing lately, and what you can expect to come in the course of this year. Also, uh, for those unfamiliar with the project, this is actually our 12th devlog, as we've been posting them on itch.io, but we're gonna start posting here as well!

First off: We've applied to the Spelkollektivet Scholarship Program! If you've been around on itch, following our blog, then you probably know that Leene and I have been living here for the past 2 months. We still have ~3 weeks to go here, and it's been amazing. We want to come back here next year and this MAY happen. If we get the scholarship it will be easier, but we will try and come back here no matter the situation.

That being said, you can check out the contenders for the program here: [url=https://www.facebook.com/watch/?v=1939443159534833]click me! [/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36100298/40e8e44e790160c1fc8e362234412b508dffca81.png[/img]

On other fronts, we've been cracking down on our roadmap, and we want to be content complete by the end of the year, which will be a hurdle, but it's still doable. We've finished the character customization system, which you can get a peek of here. We've been trying to hone our marketing skills as well, and I did some major data crunch on our visibility and demo performance here on itch! I posted my findings on reddit, and you can read the whole post (warning: LONG) here.

I'm finalizing most of the codebase for the the preparation of the full content of the game and I'm also doing some stability checks and cleanup. Our artists are at work to get all the sweet goodness of art assets in, and our writer is chugging along with the entire structure for the narrative of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36100298/89ea2d435823e8d9231a459bff7946528f02262e.png[/img]

It's a monster, alright. It's all going to come together soon! It's extremely nerve-wracking and exciting at the same time, and we hope we can make something that's truly special and that our players will love.

Thanks for all of your support thus far and thank you for joining us on this strange journey :D

Also if you haven't yet: please wishlist the game! And tell your friends about us :) 
The more people on this grim adventure, the merrier!

Much love!
